Research Paper: Attentive Contextual Network for Image Captioning

Research Paper: M-FFN: Multi-Scale Feature Fusion Network for Image Captioning
Authors: Prudviraj Jeripothula; Chalavadi Vishnu; C. Krishna Mohan
Methodology / Model: Multi-scale feature pyramid, spatial transforms, semantic attention
Key Contribution: Fuses global context and spatial features for captioning

Authors: Junnan Li; Dongxu Li; Caiming Xiong; Steven Hoi
